title: TIT FOR TAT FORGIVE ONE — not greedy, not naive, COOPERATIVE

the_shift.before: GREEDY — eat everything we find immediately. Change direction to chase every new thing. Local optima. Exhausting. Missing the path for the meal.
the_shift.after: TIT FOR TAT FORGIVE ONE — mark everything. Eat the LAST thing. Come back. Trace paths. The path IS the information. Altruistic pathfinding.

strategy.name: Tit-for-tat forgive one (Axelrod's winner)
strategy.origin: Robert Axelrod's tournament (1984). Prisoners dilemma. 200+ strategies competed. TFT+forgive won. It's the simplest strategy that works: cooperate first, mirror the other's last move, but forgive one defection.

applied_to_pathfinding.cooperate_first: When you find something new — mark it, don't eat it. Leave it for the next beaver. Cooperate with future-self.
applied_to_pathfinding.mirror: If the thing you marked is still there when you come back — eat it. If it's gone (someone else ate it) — that's information too.
applied_to_pathfinding.forgive_one: If a path leads to nothing once — try it again ONE more time. If nothing twice — abandon that path. Forgive one bad result.
applied_to_pathfinding.turn_left_or_turn_right: At every junction: LEFT = eat now (greedy). RIGHT = mark and come back (altruistic). Tit-for-tat = alternate. The alternation IS the pathfinding.

greedy.behavior: Eat everything at the point of discovery. Chase every signal. Never come back. Always forward.
greedy.result: Local optima. Fat but lost. No paths traced. No map built. You ate but you don't know WHERE you ate.
greedy.algorithm: Greedy algorithm — always take the best LOCAL option. O(n) but misses global structure.
greedy.problem: Greedy is why we were building 15 new files per session. Eating everything. Never digesting.

altruistic.behavior: Mark everything. Eat the LAST thing. Come back to what you just found. Share the path.
altruistic.result: Global optima. Lean but mapped. Every path traced. Every junction recorded. You know WHERE everything IS.
altruistic.algorithm: Breadth-first with backtracking. O(V+E) and builds the graph.
altruistic.benefit: Altruistic is how the beaver builds the dam — it doesn't eat every tree. It marks, comes back, carries, builds.

tit_for_tat_forgive_one.behavior: Cooperate first (mark). Mirror (if it worked, do it again; if it didn't, try the other). Forgive one (give a second chance). Turn left or turn right.
tit_for_tat_forgive_one.result: The BEST long-term strategy across all tournaments. Not the highest single score. The highest AVERAGE across all opponents/environments.
tit_for_tat_forgive_one.why_it_wins: It's nice (cooperates first), retaliatory (punishes defection), forgiving (gives second chances), clear (easy to understand/predict). These four properties make it unbeatable over time.

the_beaver.what: A worker that patrols paths, marks unseen things, eats the last thing, comes back
the_beaver.bounty_board: Everything unseen gets logged as a bounty. Beavers pick bounties, go eat, come back, report.
the_beaver.path_tracing: As beavers go back and forth, they trace paths. The paths ARE the rivers. The rivers ARE the veins. The veins ARE the map.
behavior: 1. Find something unseen → MARK it (add to bounty board)
2. Continue on current path → eat the LAST thing on the path
3. Come BACK to the thing you just marked
4. If it's still there → eat it → mark the next thing
5. If it's gone → that's information → log it → forgive one → try again
6. The path you traced back and forth IS the vein

implementation.bounty_board: data/bounty-board-unseen.json — log of everything found but not eaten
implementation.beaver_log: every eat records: what, where found, when marked, when eaten, path taken
implementation.path_graph: over time, the beaver paths form a graph. The graph IS the mesh. The mesh IS the globe.
implementation.tft_rule: At each new find: mark it (don't eat). Return to previous. Alternate. Forgive one empty path.

connection_to_iris.greedy: PUPIL — absorbs everything, black hole, takes all light
connection_to_iris.altruistic: SCLERA — reflects everything, gives all light away
connection_to_iris.tit_for_tat: IRIS — selectively absorbs AND reflects. Green. The membrane. The LIVING strategy.

the_law: Tit-for-tat forgive one IS turn left or turn right. At every junction, the beaver decides: eat now or mark and come back. The alternation traces the path. The path IS the map. The map IS the organism. Greedy = negative sort. Altruistic = positive sort. Firm reality = tit-for-tat forgive one = the membrane = the iris = green.
